notes:
K8Secret 0.6.17 — a fix for macOS 14, and colour that follows your theme.

If you are on macOS 14 and your cluster uses a client certificate, 0.6.15 and 0.6.16 could not connect to it. Removing a certificate from the keychain immediately after use also invalidated the identity built from it, so the handshake failed. Please update. Newer versions of macOS were unaffected.

Everywhere else, this is about colour. Eighty-nine places in the app painted with macOS's own red, orange, yellow, green and blue. Those are fixed shades that know nothing about the light or dark mode you are in, or the colour you chose for the cluster — so in light mode a crash-looping container announced itself in a pale yellow you could barely read, and status colours drifted away from everything around them. They now come from the app's palette, which has a value for each mode.

Settings drew the lines between its sections in white, which is a smear on a light panel and invisible on a dark one. The sidebar's flyout had the same edge. Both now use the same hairline as everywhere else.
